dimensions.detail: The generation, template imitation, editing, NotebookLM conversion, web search, reference-file parsing, and local PPTX operations fit a cloud-backed presentation workflow and are described in the skill artifacts.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The instructions are prescriptive about loading workflow files, polling logs, and reporting progress, but they remain scoped to PPT creation, editing, conversion, and file operations.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill declares Python and SKYWORK_API_KEY; setup installs python-pptx at runtime with --break-system-packages, which is functional but better done in an isolated environment.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The scripts read user-selected files, use a Skywork API key, call Skywork endpoints, perform web search, and download generated PPTX files; this is proportionate but privacy-sensitive.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No hidden autostart, privilege escalation, self-propagation, or unbounded persistence was found; the main residual risks are temp files/logs and local delete/reorder operations that can overwrite the source file when no output path is supplied.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: The API key, local file access, and network access are real, but the manifest declares SKYWORK_API_KEY and the main skill text discloses remote upload and prompt transmission.
[TP4] expected: Remote parsing, upload, web search, and cloud processing are broader than a purely local PPT tool, but they are part of the stated Skywork PPT workflows rather than hidden unrelated behavior.
[SDI-1] expected: Generic reference-file parsing and web search can process broad content types, but the workflows invoke them for user-provided presentation source material or topic research.
[SDI-2] expected: Authenticated uploads and remote API calls create data egress, but the observed destinations are Skywork service endpoints used for the advertised presentation features.
[SQP-2] unexpected: The verified hygiene issues include echoing the API key in setup guidance, lack of a separate per-upload confirmation prompt, temp search-result files, and in-place overwrite defaults for some local operations; these warrant user caution but do not show deception or malicious behavior.
[staticScan] expected: The supplied static scan was clean and did not add artifact-backed malicious evidence.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry was pending, so it did not affect the verdict.
llm.guidance: Use this only with files and prompts you are comfortable sending to Skywork. Prefer a dedicated API key, avoid printing or sharing the key, run Python dependencies in a virtual environment, and specify an output path or keep backups before local delete/reorder operations.
llm.summary: This is a disclosed Skywork PowerPoint helper that sends selected files and prompts to Skywork, so it is usable but not for sensitive content unless you trust that service.
